retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered composition featuring high-contrast monochrome portraits overlaid with technical geometric line-work and a bold, angular red graphic element.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition containing four male figures in high-contrast black and white, set against a background of fine-line geometric diagrams. A large, thick red 'V' or clock-hand shape bisects the frame, complemented by a red border with tick marks and wide-tracked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome figures contrasted against a vibrant red geometric overlay
Fine technical line-work providing texture behind solid human forms
Extreme horizontal expansion of top-aligned text versus wide tracking of bottom-aligned text
Angular red border ticks framing the central group portrait
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for subjects
Primary red accent color for all graphic overlays

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a staggered diagonal line from left to right, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, bold red angular shape (resembling clock hands) positioned centrally over the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the wide red header, follows the diagonal line of the figures downward, and is caught by the red angular graphic that points toward the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The background is filled with dense but light-weight geometric lines, creating a 'busy' but low-contrast negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white background with high-saturation red accents and high-contrast black shadows in the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme horizontal scaling for the top display text
Wide letter spacing for the bottom text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg
The 'E' has equal length horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family used with different widths and tracking to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 80s technical aesthetic and horizontal stretch.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with four men in 80s attire, rendered in high-contrast black and white photography. The background should be white with faint, light-grey technical drawings, blueprints, and geometric arcs. Include a thick red border with small red tick marks pointing inward. Place a large, bold red 'V' shape or clock-hand graphic over the center of the figures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an ultra-extended red sans-serif font at the top. Add the secondary title in a black sans-serif font at the bottom with extremely wide tracking so it spans the full width of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the top text horizontally stretched?
Is the bottom text ultra-wide tracked?
Are the portraits high-contrast black and white?
Is the red graphic element bold and angular?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the portrait
Thickness of the red graphic overlay
Degree of horizontal stretch in the top font
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red color is vibrant and consistent across all elements.
Verify that the technical background lines do not obscure the faces.
Check that the top text is clearly legible despite the horizontal stretch.
Confirm the bottom text tracking is wide enough to reach both edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + Technical line-work background + Bold red geometric overlay + Extended sans-serif typography.
